description: Pinned third-party/vendor assets used by Dikte's UI. Every entry records source URL, sha256 and license. Refresh only through this manifest; inspect diffs before accepting.

Inter-Variable.ttf.role: body face fallback (docs/fonts statics load first)

icons.set: Lucide stroke SVGs (ISC), 56 files under assets/fonts/icons/
icons.mapping: Dikte icon key -> Lucide file, with sha256 per file, in vendor/font-license-notes.md section 2

rules: Only .ttf/.otf/.svg vendor files; never executables or code.
Every file pinned here with source URL, sha256 and license before use.
Loaded at runtime via QFontDatabase (fonts) and ui/icons.py (SVG); docs/fonts/ statics remain the first-choice body/mono faces.
